# Fixture Media

`clean_tapping_sample.ogg`

- Source page: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Clean_tapping_sample.ogg
- Direct download used to vendor the file:
  `https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:Redirect/file/Clean%20tapping%20sample.ogg`
- Description: "A tapping melody played on an electric guitar."
- Author: `Meanos`
- License: public domain (`PD-self`) per the Wikimedia Commons file page.

This file is used only as a small real-music sample for animatic / previz smoke fixtures.
The test fixture transcodes it to WAV locally before injecting it into the project so the
existing asset-validation path stays unchanged.
